resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register, Firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb all give 1936 for the L-4 cab, but the panoramas taken from the lookout are dated August 8, 1935. The sources do not explain the gap, so the 1936 build year is reported as given and flagged for review

The Register and Firelookout.com give 1,720 ft for the coordinates in the record; WillhiteWeb reports 1,281 to 1,515 ft near Bedal Campground, calls 1,720 ft the old road crossing, and places the lookout lower

notes_for_editor: Two open questions. (1) Build year: the Register, Firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb give 1936, yet the lookout's own panoramas are dated August 8, 1935 (Register and Forest Lookouts); not resolved, so the story reports both. (2) Location and elevation: the record's coordinates (48.10343, -121.37796) match the Register and sit at 524 m (1,720 ft). WillhiteWeb says 1,720 ft is where an old road crosses the ridge and places the lookout lower, at about 1,515 ft or below the railroad grade, near Bedal Campground. No corrected coordinates are given, so no correction is proposed; a human should check the point. WillhiteWeb also suggests an unlabelled 1937 photo, mislabelled White Chuck Bench, may show this lookout; that is its own suggestion and is not used. Access details rest on WillhiteWeb; a single web search about Bedal Campground was not read from a page and is not cited.
